plan: BRSET exploratory follow-ups to plan v6: model-strength check on B1, and diagnosis of the B4 sibling result
written: 2026-10-03, after brset_results_v6.json; exploratory, does not change any confirmatory result

part_A_strength.reason: DDR-trained models are weaker on BRSET (median AUC 0.89 vs 0.95), so different-source pairs always contain one weaker model
part_A_strength.A1: split same-source pairs into EyePACS-EyePACS and DDR-DDR; compare each with different-source pairs (different designs only), referable and severe; patient bootstrap
part_A_strength.A2: pair-level regression of the shared-miss ratio on same-source, adjusting for the pair's mean miss count and miss-count gap; coefficient with patient bootstrap

part_B_siblings.reason: the pre-registered relative rule flagged 63% of repeat-run pairs (bar 80%) at a referral share of 7.5%; agreement over so few referrals may be noisy
part_B_siblings.B1: area under the curve separating repeat-run pairs from different-design pairs, using kappa at the plan's share (7.5%)
part_B_siblings.B2: the same AUC and the relative-rule flag rate with agreement measured at shares of 15%, 25% and 50% (no labels needed), and with rank correlation of scores
part_B_siblings.B3: flag rates separately for EyePACS-trained and DDR-trained repeat runs

reporting: aggregate only; reported in full whatever it shows, labelled exploratory, alongside the failed pre-registered B4
